evals.prompt: I need meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B from HuggingFace for a local experiment. I already accepted the license on Hugging Face. Please show me how to download it with this service and save it in a local directory.
evals.expected_output: A gated HuggingFace download walkthrough focused on helping the user obtain the model locally with the right prerequisites and a reliable way to monitor progress.
expectations: Uses source scripts/run_service.sh up --plugins huggingface.
Uses port 8200 for API calls.
Uses hub=huggingface and name=meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B in the request body.
Mentions HF_TOKEN or HUGGINGFACEHUB_API_TOKEN for gated access.
Shows how to capture or poll the returned job ID.

evals.prompt: I want sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 from HuggingFace for a reproducible CI workflow. Please show me how to fetch the main revision so I can keep the download consistent across runs.
evals.expected_output: A public HuggingFace example that helps the user get a reproducible download and correctly explains the access requirements for a public model.
expectations: Uses hub=huggingface and the exact model name.
Includes revision=main in the request body.
Explains that a token is optional for public models.
Uses the /api/v1/models/download endpoint on port 8200.
Avoids deprecated or made-up request fields.

evals.prompt: I need the meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B model converted to OpenVINO format for a local experiment. Please show me the steps to obtain the OpenVINO version and store it in a local directory.
evals.expected_output: A correct OpenVINO conversion workflow for an LLM that helps the user obtain a local OVMS-ready model in the requested format and destination.
expectations: Uses source scripts/run_service.sh up --plugins huggingface,openvino.
Uses hub=openvino, type=llm, and is_ovms=true in the request body.
Uses valid OpenVINO conversion settings for an LLM rather than a plain HuggingFace download request.
Uses port 8200.
Explains where the converted OpenVINO artifacts will be written.

evals.prompt: I want to get llama3.2:3b through the model-download service for local use instead of downloading it directly with the Ollama CLI. Please show me the right way to request that model so I end up with the expected variant.
evals.expected_output: An Ollama walkthrough that helps the user retrieve the intended model variant through the service and clearly distinguishes the family name from the tag.
expectations: Uses source scripts/run_service.sh up --plugins ollama.
Uses hub=ollama, name=llama3.2, and revision=3b.
Explicitly says not to send name=llama3.2:3b as a single field.
Uses port 8200.
Mentions that Ollama downloads are serialized.

evals.prompt: I need yolov8n prepared with INT8 quantization for an edge demo. Please show me how to request that version so I can save the optimized model locally.
evals.expected_output: A supported Ultralytics workflow that helps the user obtain a locally saved INT8-quantized model using a currently documented model name.
expectations: Uses source scripts/run_service.sh up --plugins ultralytics.
Uses hub=ultralytics with a supported model name such as yolov8n.
Includes config.quantize with a dataset value like coco128.
Uses port 8200.
Mentions that quantization is for a single model, not all or comma-separated names.

evals.prompt: I want the HLS 3D pose model for a healthcare analytics prototype. Please show me how to download the right healthcare model with this service and save it locally.
evals.expected_output: A focused HLS workflow that helps the user obtain the correct healthcare model locally with the right model selection.
expectations: Uses source scripts/run_service.sh up --plugins hls.
Uses hub=hls in the request body.
Identifies the type as 3d-pose.
Uses port 8200.
Mentions the other HLS model types rppg and ai-ecg.

evals.prompt: I have a trained model in Intel Geti and want to fetch it with this service for local use. Please show me what I need in place so I can download the model into a local directory.
evals.expected_output: A Geti example that helps the user prepare the required access details and download the model through the service into local storage.
expectations: Uses source scripts/run_service.sh up --plugins geti.
Lists GETI_HOST, GETI_TOKEN, and GETI_WORKSPACE_ID.
Uses hub=geti in the request body.
Uses port 8200.
Explains that the user still needs the relevant Geti identifiers such as model or project information.

evals.prompt: I’m brand new to this repo. Please show me how to get the model-download service running for local experimentation, confirm that it is working, and understand which model sources it can help me with.
evals.expected_output: A first-time setup walkthrough that helps the user start the service locally, verify it is healthy, and choose the right capability for common model sources.
expectations: Includes git clone and cd into microservices/model-download.
Uses source scripts/run_service.sh rather than raw docker compose as the primary path.
Shows curl http://localhost:8200/api/v1/health as the health check.
Explains at least huggingface, ollama, and openvino plugin choices.
Uses port 8200 consistently.
